definition: to use something for a job
description: At a farm gate by a vineyard on a sunny day, a smiling young woman in a straw hat, denim shirt and work trousers leans on an open wooden gate while a flock of sheep walks past her through the gate in a small cloud of dust. She laughs, stands up and pats one of the sheep. A small ride-on mower stands unused under a black cover behind her at the end of the vines. A brown and white dog lies calmly on the grass in front, and dry golden hills rise under the clear sky.

en.question: What is the woman leaning against?

de.answer: Sie lehnt sich an ein Holztor.
de.question: Woran lehnt sich die Frau?

es.answer: Se está apoyando en una cancela de madera.
phrases: acariciar la cabeza de una oveja
es.question: ¿En qué se está apoyando la mujer?

fr.answer: Elle s'appuie contre une barrière en bois.
fr.question: Contre quoi la femme s'appuie-t-elle ?
